title: Thai-Style Coconut Rice
description: A simple and flavorful Thai dish made with coconut milk, fluffy rice, and a hint of nutty spices.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add Chinese sausage and cook, breaking up with a spoon, until browned, about 4-5 minutes.
Add coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add fluffy rice and stir to coat with coconut milk mixture.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until rice is cooked and liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in nutty peanuts and serve hot.
